sinopsis.es: Gugu tiene 12 años y crece en una pequeña comunidad a orillas del embalse Araújo-Lima, cuyo nivel desciende gradualmente revelando las ruinas de una ciudad sumergida. Vive con su abuela Dilma, rodeado de ternura, picardía y tardes de fútbol.
sinopsis.en: Twelve-year-old Gugu grows up in a small community on the banks of the Araújo-Lima reservoir, whose waters are slowly receding to reveal the ruins of a submerged town. He lives with his grandmother Dilma, surrounded by tenderness, mischief, and afternoons of football.
